items.title: Mitchel McAllister Interview, 1960-03-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He used to play with the Superior Band, Bunk Jonte. [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: I don't know. I didn't know where he... He told me he used to drum sometime, but he came here... Well, he played with some great band. Oh yeah, Brundy was... That's a good clarinet player. He came here playing good. Very nice clarinet.
He used to play with the Superior Band, Bunk Jonte.
